title: Design exercise: SAA-4.4-S07
scenario: Penhallow Survey Group is opening a drone-imagery processing branch in 3 weeks. The branch must sync imagery to AWS at a sustained 3 Gbps during working hours, traffic must be encrypted, and the branch router's vendor supports tunnels of at most 1.25 Gbps. The carrier quotes at least 6 weeks to deliver any dedicated physical circuit. The AWS side already has a Transit Gateway that the company's four VPCs attach to.
constraints: Do not claim live AWS experience
The branch opens in 3 weeks, so nothing that needs a new physical circuit can be relied on
If any one tunnel fails, at least 2 Gbps must still flow
Finance will not pay for more tunnel capacity than the stated figures require

rubric.label: The allocation provides at least 3 Gbps at the documented per-tunnel ceiling, still provides at least 2 Gbps with any one tunnel down, and carries no more than one tunnel beyond the minimum that achieves both
The record explains why a single tunnel, a dedicated physical circuit and a larger tunnel type are each unsuitable given the stated dates and device limit

constraint_reason: Mapped as design_exercise to complete skill coverage when no dedicated live lab step exists
